headline: Things worth keeping, priced without theatre

assurances.title: Pay at the door
assurances.text: Cash when it arrives. Nothing is charged online, and there is no card to enter.

assurances.title: Free delivery
assurances.text: Orders over {amount} arrive free. Below that, a flat fee shown before you confirm.

assurances.title: Real stock counts
assurances.text: What you see is what is on the shelf. If it is running low, we say how low.
